ns:interface.name: item_detail
ns:interface.documentation: Interface to carry out CRUD (maintenance) operations of an item object. For update methods, it is expected that the client first calls the "fetch" method and then submits the modified item record appropriately.

method.name: fetch
method.documentation:
fetch:
Inputs: org_id and item_identifier (mandatory)
Outputs: item_detail object of the given org_id and item_identifier
Description: Retrieves an item_detail object for the given org_id and item_identifier
Errors: Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs Throws errors if the item record does not exist

method.name: add
method.documentation:
add:
Inputs: item_detail
Outputs: None
Description: Adds a new item_detail object
Errors: Throws errors if the input is invalid or missing Throws errors if the item already exists

method.name: modify
method.documentation:
modify:
Inputs: item_detail of the given item_identifier
Outputs: None
Description: Updates an item_detail object in the Inventory database
Errors: Throws errors if the input is invalid or missing Throws errors if the item does not exist

method.name: delete
method.documentation:
delete:
Inputs: item_detail of the given item_identifier
Outputs: None
Description: Marks an item_detail object in the Inventory database as deleted
Errors: Throws errors if the input is invalid or missing Throws errors if the item does not exist

method.name: undelete
method.documentation:
undelete:
Inputs: item_detail of the given item_identifier
Outputs: None
Description: Marks an item_detail object in the Inventory database as not deleted
Errors: Throws errors if the input is invalid or missing Throws errors if the item does not exist

method.name: list
method.documentation:
list:
Inputs: query_params with one or more of item_identifier, item_name, category, price_range, availability
Outputs: List of item_detail objects matching the input criteria
Description: Retrieves a list of matching item_detail records
Errors: Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
